تختلبن (form VIII)
# تَخْتَلِبْنَ (taḵtalibna) /tax.ta.lib.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
# تُخْتَلَبْنَ (tuḵtalabna) /tux.ta.lab.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
